newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends just firmer.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends just firmer.

text.p: LIFFE white sugar futures mustered further gains on nearby short-covering on Friday and ended just firmer on the day.
Spot December last traded at $306.90 a tonne, up $1.20, while the second-month March traded 70 cts higher at $305.90 after a peak of $306.90. Total turnover reached 3,313 lots.
Traders said volume on nearbys was encouraging and buyers, although apparently backing off late, could be tempted again.
But the outlook depended on physical offtake which was no more than a routine schedule of purchases at present.

"Perhaps for the time being the market may be near the lows but I would imagine over the course of next week if there is no further offtake the market would start its way back down again," said one trader.
"The RSI is currently attempting to break out of oversold levels and this could help push prices higher," said trade house Sucden in a comment on March sugar.
